method: Parse actual retained V2 teacher expression strings, compile to NOR, evaluate every input using codec evaluator, compare against original independent scalar integer oracles.
comparison_limit: One observation per model/profile/representation; prompts and constrained response grammar changed together. Observed improvement is not a controlled causal attribution or broad language-model quality claim.

expression_outputs: ~a & b & ~carry_in | a & ~b & carry_in | a & b & carry_in
